name: 实现 实时日志推送 接口
description: 实现 WS /ws/deployments/{id}/logs: WebSocket 双向通道。建立连接后服务器持续推送部署执行日志。消息格式：{"type":"log","data":{"timestamp":"datetime","level":"info|warn|error","message":"string"}} 或 {"type":"status","data":{"status":"running|success|failed"}} 或 {"type":"heartbeat","data":{}}。客户端发送 {"type":"ping"} 保持连接
